notes: Synthetic, deliberately malformed dispute for the Gnosis fixture. Not loaded by anything. It models a non-standard arbitrable whose meta-evidence does not follow ERC-1497 (title is an object, rulingOptions is a string). Rendering it currently crashes the Ongoing Disputes page (OngoingCard renders the title as a React child). To use it, add the id to openDisputeIDs in 100.json and copy arbitratorDispute and metaEvidence under that id.
